container-scale.name: Container GUI Scale
container-scale.description:
This feature has several issues and is not finished! Some screens may be slightly broken, and other mods may have issues pop up!

Allows setting a different GUI scale for containers, such as your inventory or chests.

prevent-closing-screens.name: Prevent Closing Screens
prevent-closing-screens.description:
Prevents the server from forcefully closing your screens. For example, your chat screen when a Hypixel SkyWars game starts.

Created by Moulberry in MoulberrysTweaks.

dont-reset-cursor.name: Don't Reset Cursor
dont-reset-cursor.description:
Keeps your cursor in the same spot when opening a new screen immediately after the last. For example, backpack slots in Hypixel SkyBlock.

Created by nea89o in Firmament.

Automatically disabled when Firmament is installed.

cursor-reset-timer.name: Cursor Reset Timer
cursor-reset-timer.description: The amount of time needed between screen opens for the timer to reset. Set to 0 to have the cursor never reset.

remove-status-effect-shift.name: Remove Status Effect Shift
remove-status-effect-shift.description: Prevents status effects from shifting the inventory position. This makes no attempt to fit the status effect in your screen if your GUI scale is too large.

click-out-of-containers.name: Click out of Containers
click-out-of-containers.description: Lets you click outside the bounds of a container to close it.

replace-open-to-lan.name: Replace Open to Lan
replace-open-to-lan.description: Replaces the Open to Lan button in Multiplayer with a Server List button.

show-server-preview.name: Direct Connect Server Preview
show-server-preview.description: Show a server preview for your set IP in the direct connect screen.

container-background-opacity.name: Container Background Opacity
container-background-opacity.description: Set the transparency of container backgrounds.

container-texture-opacity.name: Container Texture Opacity
container-texture-opacity.description: Set the transparency of container textures.

container-label-color.name: Container Label Color
container-label-color.description: Set the color of the container name text.

player-inventory-label-color.name: Player Inventory Label Color
player-inventory-label-color.description: Set the color of the player inventory text when inside a container.
